notes.title: UPDATE!!
notes.notes:
One of MOM's flibbles was a lot more jellied than we thought, so we made some fixes

The shoreline audio will not cause crashes on surround sound systems
Reduced likelihood of loud bursts of audio after extended play
The flower of the final STARPLANT will not close around BUD once fully grown
Youch! achievement is less awkward to unlock
Crystals should be less likely to become blocked by nearby branches
Snapler floraforms should no longer kill BUD when he’s far away
The toy bull will be better behaved for Cuddly Meeps achievement
Some improvements to resolution detection with portrait oriented monitors
Battery power will no longer re-generate while in POD view
BUD is now 0.006% better at playing Tic-Tac-Toe, but so is MOM
